overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate the Town Meeting warrant discussion more than 48 hours before the retreat, so it need not have been listed. The AG strongly encouraged postponing unlisted topics, but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board used a retreat to vote down Special Town Meeting warrant articles that were not on the posted agenda.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing topics at its November 5, 2011 meeting that were not listed in the meeting notice because they were not reasonably anticipated by the Chair more than 48 hours before the meeting
